scale: 0-100 when evaluable; null/UNKNOWN when not evaluable

category_normalization.description: Use the leading source code before explanatory parenthetical text. Do not convert between IUCN and Article 17 categories. Select the mapping by category_system/authority.

aggregation.description: After latest-within-logical-unit selection, final score = 0.8 * highest weighted assessment + 0.2 * mean of up to three highest weighted assessments from distinct logical units.

conflict_policy.same_unit_same_version_incompatible_cate: UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT; preserve all evidence; scoring projection uses precautionary maximum evaluable severity

rationale.threat_categories: IUCN categories measure extinction risk and retain the primary severity scale.
rationale.article_17: Habitats Directive Article 17 conservation status is biological conservation evidence, not an IUCN Red List category; it therefore uses an explicitly separate transformation. FV is low concern, U1 intermediate adverse status, U2 strong adverse status, and XX remains unknown.
rationale.territory: For a La Rioja collection programme, regional and Spanish evidence has greatest operational relevance; continental/global assessments are supportive; unrelated European jurisdictions are retained with lower relevance.
rationale.time: Older valid assessments remain evidence but are attenuated in the working score rather than discarded.
rationale.dd: Data Deficient is not low risk; a precautionary intermediate value is used while DD remains explicitly identifiable in evidence.
